A pending approval handed to somebody else to answer (M5.5): a teammate, a role, or the lane's lead. Chips resolves `to` to ids, as it does on the request.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`approval.routed.json`](/schema/approval.routed.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"approval.routed"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `approval_id` | yes | `string` | A approval identifier: `apr_` followed by a ULID. |
| `to` | yes | `string[]` | Who should answer, as the router asks it: `owner`, `any`, `role:<name>`, `lead`, or a person id — the same words as `approvers` on the request. |
| `approvers` | no | `string[]` | Who may answer now, as ids. Filled in by Chips from `to`; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `ask` | no | object | What the ask is, written by Chips from the approval. Somebody handed an ask in a room they are not in never saw the request that raised it (ADR 0042), and this is what their card is drawn from; whoever is in the room has the request itself and ignores this. |
| `ask.harness_id` | yes | `string` | The harness that asked. |
| `ask.action` | yes | `{ kind: string; }` | The action as the harness proposed it. |

| `ask.expires_at` | no | `string` | When it expires, if it does. |
| `reason` | no | `string` | Why it was handed on, for the card and the audit. |
| `routed_by` | no | `string` | Who handed it on. Filled in by Chips from the credential. |
| `routed_at` | no | `string` | When. Filled in by Chips from its clock. |
